title: Dos Santos breaks 400m hurdles world record in Zurich
dek: Brazil's Alison dos Santos set a new 400m hurdles world record of 45.80 seconds at the Diamond League final in Zurich, per BBC Sport. The performance establishes a new ceiling for the event at an elite international competition.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Alison dos Santos ran 45.80 seconds in the 400m hurdles at the Diamond League final in Zurich, breaking the world record.
bottom_line: The record stands as the fastest 400m hurdles time ever recorded. Watch for dos Santos' next competitive appearance and whether other elite 400m hurdlers respond to the new benchmark.
body: Brazil's Alison dos Santos ran 45.80 seconds in the 400m hurdles at the Diamond League final in Zurich, breaking the world record, according to BBC Sport.

The performance marks a new high-water mark for the event at one of track and field's marquee international competitions. Dos Santos, an Olympic-tier performer in his event, set the time on the Diamond League circuit, the sport's premier meet series.
